prompt: Which of these are valid, idiomatic `when` clause matchers for `case n`?
explanation: case/when relies on === for matching, which is why ranges, classes, and regexes all work as when arms.

options.text: `when Integer` matches when the case value is an Integer
Regular expression literals can be used as when arms to pattern-match strings
case/when always uses == for comparisons, never ===
